title: Status Tracker — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Status Tracker solution should meet the objective: Model a small workflow with an enum and explicit permitted transitions. Test an invalid transition as well as the happy path. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
